verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a client-side rendering/game engine library consumed via JS/TS APIs, not a network service exposing a REST API; OpenAPI/Swagger specs describe HTTP API surfaces, which don't apply to this kind of product. The probe confirms no openapi.json/swagger.json exists, but that's expected since the product has no HTTP API to describe — this is a category mismatch rather than a missing capability.
